welcome: 🥝 WELCOME TO KIWISMIR! 🥝 🎉🎉🎉 You just found the fastest, friendliest media grabber on Telegram! 🎉🎉🎉 I snatch photos and videos straight off: 📌 Pinterest ▶️ YouTube 🎵 TikTok 📸 Instagram Just paste any link and watch the magic happen. ✨ • 📷 Photo link? I send it back instantly. • 🎬 Video link? Pick .mp3 or .mp4, then choose your quality. Let's get downloading! 🚀
language_set: ✅ Language set to English. Send me a link whenever you're ready!
invalid_link: 🤨 Please send me a valid link (Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok or Instagram).
choose_format: 🎬 Got a video! Which format do you want?
no_hd: ⚠️ There is no 1080p+ quality available for this video.
error: 💥 Something went wrong while grabbing that. Try another link.
too_big: 📦 That file is too big for Telegram (over %d MB). Try a lower quality.
unsupported: 🚫 I couldn't find any media at that link.
backend_unavailable: ⚠️ My downloader is having trouble right now. Please try again in a minute.
no_formats: 🚫 No downloadable video formats found for this link.
session_expired: ⌛ That request expired. Please send the link again.
help: 🥝 kiwismir help Send me a link from Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok or Instagram and I'll download it for you. For any questions, message my creator: @EthanMonza (I will reply within 1-3 days). Commands /start - Welcome message /language - Change your language /help - Show this help
twitter_requires_login: 🔒 That post is locked behind an X/Twitter login (age-restricted or sensitive) — I can't download it. The bot admin can enable cookies via COOKIES_FILE.
twitter_no_media: 🚫 I couldn't find any media in that post — it may be text-only, deleted, or from a protected account.
twitter_media_count: 📎 %d media in this post — sending the first one.
spotify_full_disabled: 💡 Albums and playlists need full Spotify mode — the bot admin can enable it with SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID and SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET. Single tracks still work!
spotify_confirm: 📋 %s — %d tracks. How much do you want?
spotify_too_many: 😅 That's %d tracks — over my 300-track limit. Try a smaller list!
spotify_no_tracks: 🚫 No downloadable tracks in there — local and unavailable files get skipped.
spotify_fetch_fail: 🚫 Couldn't read that album/playlist. Check the link and try again.
spotify_rate_limited: 🐢 Spotify is rate-limiting me right now. Give it a minute and try again.
spotify_help_hint: 💡 Want Spotify albums & playlists? The bot admin can enable full mode via SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID and SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET — single tracks work either way.
